title: Found by Requester
alt: Five panels. 1: In the office at night, a lavender folder has just come out of the brass pneumatic tube with a fwump. Pip holds it, worried, and reads: Lavender. Case 0212. The paper's gone soft. Margo, at her desk with her mug, eyebrows up, says: Again. 2: Margo, behind her desk with the drawer open, has set out a tall bundle of identical lavender folders tied with string. Pip reads the label: Requester: M. Voss, age seven. 3: Close-up of Pip holding a small slip covered in a child's wobbly writing, looking up, reading it aloud: Find Mum's pearl button. Please. 4: Close-up of Margo, softened, her hand at the mismatched pearly top button of her cardigan, looking down at Pip. She says: I came looking. I found it myself. Pip, small, looking up, says: Then stamp it. 5: Wide. At the desk under the night window, a form lies flat with a new hand-drawn box, ticked, lettered FOUND BY REQUESTER. Margo holds the stamp poised above the box and says: Found by requester isn't a category. Pip, standing proudly with a pen, says: It is now.
hover: The bundle stays in the drawer. Closed cases get filed too.
transcript: Panel 1 – PIP: Lavender. Case 0212. The paper's gone soft.
Panel 2 – PIP: Requester: M. Voss, age seven.
Panel 3 – PIP: "Find Mum's pearl button. Please."
Panel 4 – MARGO: I came looking. I found it myself.
Panel 5 – MARGO: "Found by requester" isn't a category.
note: This is the one the button tin and the pink copies were waiting for. It got an extra panel.
